description: This file contains the CustomField class in the Opencart project, responsible for retrieving custom field data from the database within the account model namespace.

classes.name: CustomField
classes.description: Handles retrieval of custom field information from the database, including single and multiple field fetch operations.

methods.name: getCustomField
methods.description: Fetches a single custom field record by its ID, joining description details and considering the current language setting.

methods.name: getCustomFields
methods.description: Retrieves multiple custom fields, optionally filtered by customer group ID, and includes associated values for select, radio, and checkbox types.
